bugs.name: Exclusive label Priority/Low cannot be found by its complete saved name in issue Labels filter
bugs.summary: In the issue sidebar's Labels menu, typing the complete saved name of the existing exclusive label "Priority/Low" removes the label from the list and shows "No results found."
bugs.expected: Filtering by the label's exact saved name "Priority/Low" should keep that label in the menu so it can be selected.
bugs.actual: The menu shows "No results found." and the Priority/Low label cannot be selected through the filter.
reproSteps: Use the saved session for the disposable fixture admin account (eval).
Open /eval/harbor-handbook/labels and confirm that the exclusive label Priority/Low exists (it is shown as a split 'Priority | Low' badge).
Click the gear next to Labels in the right sidebar.
Type Priority/Low into the Filter Label box.
bugs.reason: User rejected this claim after checking that both scope and value can be searched together. The picker searches rendered text with the scope and value concatenated: for the exclusive label foo/foo1, foo, foo1 and foofoo1 all find it. The literal slash query foo/foo1 and space query foo foo1 do not match. The reported full-name miss is real, but a requirement to normalize slash/space separators is not established; it is not a failure to search both components. Reject this exact separator-formatting claim, not a report where scope, value or the concatenated text actually fails.
